 Coram : Smt. M. S. Jawalkar And Pravin S. 
Date : September 02, 2025.
.
It is contended that though the land is shown to be acquired under the Award dated 11/3/1994, but till date there is no actual handing over of possession.

Accordingly, Petitioner seeks declaration that land in question be declared as lapsed under Section 24(2) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 2. Hence, issue notice to the Respondents, returnable after three weeks.

3. Ms. Sapkal, the learned AGP waives service of notice on behalf of the Respondent Nos.1 and 2.
